extensionDescription.message: Choose a language for Google Maps, temporarily for one tab or as your saved default.

popupIntro.message: Choose a language for this tab.

persistentHint.message: Save the next selection as the default for future Maps visits.

temporaryHint.message: Only this tab, until it closes or Chrome restarts.

settingsTitle.message: Your lang for google map — Settings

notMaps.message: Open Google Maps to change this tab’s language.

savedDefault.message: Default saved and applied to this tab.

applyError.message: Could not apply the language. Check that this tab is still on Google Maps and try again.

loadError.message: Could not load settings. Reload the extension and try again.

settingsIntro.message: Make Maps feel familiar. Choose your default language and the shortcuts in your menu.

defaultHint.message: Used when Maps loads, unless that tab has a temporary selection. Open tabs update on their next page load.

shortcutsHint.message: Choose up to 6 languages, in menu order. Choose “None” to leave a slot empty. All languages remain available under More.

saveError.message: Could not save settings. Please try again.

interfaceLanguageHint.message: This interface follows Chrome’s display language, independently of your Maps selection. Unsupported interface languages use English.
